title: LinguistixDiscoveryDocument
description: Document served at /.well-known/linguistix.json. Product name Linguistix; protocol id logistix. Agents ignore unknown properties. A byte-identical copy may also be served at /.well-known/logistix.json.

product.description: Product name. The wire protocol id remains logistix.

protocol_version.description: Value the seller sends in the Logistix-Version response header.

acp_version.description: Agentic Commerce Protocol checkout version these sessions align with.

stripe_network_profile.description: Stripe network business profile. Required when capabilities.agentic_payment is true. Must match payment.stripe_network_profile.

stripe_account.description: Stripe account id (acct_…) when the seller publishes one.

mount.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the seller HTTP API, with no trailing slash. Paths in the OpenAPI document are relative to this URL. Conventional path: /api/logistix.

openapi.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the OpenAPI document for api.mount. Recommended path: /.well-known/linguistix-openapi.yaml.

mode.description: published: auth.token is a public agent credential. out_of_band: follow auth.instructions. none: the mount accepts unauthenticated calls.

token.description: Public agent credential. Present only when mode is published. This is not an admin secret.

instructions.description: How to send the published token, or how to obtain one when mode is out_of_band.

method.description: The paying agent collects a payment method in an embedded third-party widget, issues a Stripe Shared Payment Token, and sends it as payment_data.token on checkout complete. See payment.collection.

stripe_network_profile.description: Profile passed to Stripe as seller_details[network_business_profile] when the agent issues the Shared Payment Token.

collection.description: How the paying agent collects a payment method. These values are fixed for every Linguistix seller.

cardholder_data_in_chat.description: The buyer must never type a card number, PAN, or CVC into the model or as free text in chat.

primary_ui.description: Collect the payment method with a third-party payment UI embedded in the chat interface.

widgets.description: Acceptable embedded widgets, such as the Stripe Payment Element, Elements, or a wallet.

redirect_to_checkout_page.description: Sending the buyer to a separate checkout page is not the primary path.

requires_action.description: 3DS and other requires_action steps stay inside the same embedded payment widget when possible.

hosted_payment_url.description: An external payment_url or hosted payment page is a last resort when the chat cannot embed a widget. Complete still sends an spt_ token.

seller_receives.description: POST /checkout_sessions/{id}/complete accepts payment_data.token (spt_…) only, never raw card data.

instructions.description: Same rules in prose for agents that read the discovery document as text.

fulfillment.description: Ticket delivery is digital (email and wallet). Sellers do not collect a shipping address.
